description: Defines the ProxyInfo class which manages proxy configuration and resolution details within the net namespace, including methods for setting proxy types, checking proxy properties, and handling proxy fallback logic.

classes.name: ProxyInfo
classes.description: Manages proxy configuration, including proxy type, list, fallback, and timing information.

methods.name: Use
methods.description: Sets the proxy info to use the same proxy server as another ProxyInfo object.

methods.name: UseDirect
methods.description: Configures the proxy info to use a direct connection.

methods.name: UseDirectWithBypassedProxy
methods.description: Configures a direct connection indicating it bypassed proxy rules.

methods.name: UseNamedProxy
methods.description: Sets a specific proxy server or list of proxies from a string.

methods.name: UseProxyServer
methods.description: Sets a single proxy server.

methods.name: UsePacString
methods.description: Parses and uses proxy info from a PAC string.

methods.name: UseProxyList
methods.description: Uses a list of proxies.

methods.name: OverrideProxyList
methods.description: Overrides current proxy list without resetting other settings.

methods.name: is_direct
methods.description: Checks if the proxy info specifies a direct connection.

methods.name: is_direct_only
methods.description: Checks if the proxy info is only a direct connection with no fallback.

methods.name: is_https
methods.description: Checks if the first proxy is an HTTPS proxy.

methods.name: is_http_like
methods.description: Checks if the first proxy is HTTP-like.

methods.name: is_secure_http_like
methods.description: Checks if the first proxy is an HTTP proxy over a secure connection.

methods.name: is_http
methods.description: Checks if the first proxy is an HTTP proxy.

methods.name: is_quic
methods.description: Checks if the first proxy is a QUIC proxy.

methods.name: is_socks
methods.description: Checks if the first proxy is a SOCKS proxy.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.description: Checks if there are no proxies left to try.

methods.name: did_bypass_proxy
methods.description: Indicates if the proxy resolution bypassed proxy rules.

methods.name: proxy_server
methods.description: Returns the first valid proxy server.

methods.name: proxy_list
methods.description: Returns the list of proxies.

methods.name: ToPacString
methods.description: Returns the proxy info as a PAC string.

methods.name: Fallback
methods.description: Marks a proxy as bad and attempts fallback to the next proxy.

methods.name: DeprioritizeBadProxies
methods.description: Moves bad proxies to the end of the list to deprioritize them.

methods.name: RemoveProxiesWithoutScheme
methods.description: Removes proxies that do not match specified schemes.

methods.name: set_proxy_resolve_start_time
methods.description: Sets the start time of proxy resolution.

methods.name: proxy_resolve_start_time
methods.description: Gets the start time of proxy resolution.

methods.name: set_proxy_resolve_end_time
methods.description: Sets the end time of proxy resolution.

methods.name: proxy_resolve_end_time
methods.description: Gets the end time of proxy resolution.

methods.name: set_traffic_annotation
methods.description: Sets the traffic annotation for proxy resolution.

methods.name: traffic_annotation
methods.description: Gets the traffic annotation.

methods.name: proxy_retry_info
methods.description: Returns the map of proxy retry information.
